title: my first game: a folk-horror card auto-battler. honest feedback wanted (free browser demo)
author: naveed_qasim56
selftext:
this is the first thing i've ever released. it's a dark card auto-battler inspired by the games i grew up with. gamers will probably spot the influences, but i've tried hard to keep it my own.
    
    honest note: i'm not the best artist or coder, so **i used ai tools for the art, voice and code**. the vision and every design decision are mine.
    
    i know there's a lot to improve, and i need real players to tell me where it's boring, unfair or confusing.
    
    free demo in your browser: https://naveedqasim.itch.io/hosts-table

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
...The performance is completely unacceptable. Felt like it was 2FPS, playing in the browser. 

  
Aside from that... this is just Inscryption. What, you 'grew up' playing a game released 5 years ago? Gamers will 'probably spot the influence' ??? 

What about this is your own, at all? It's literally just Inscryption with the numbers filed off.

replies.author: naveed_qasim56
replies.body:
fair on the performance, that one’s on me. it’s tuned too heavy for a lot of machines in the browser, and i’m pushing a fix that drops the effects automatically when it’s struggling. thanks for saying it.

on inscryption: i did say up front that gamers would recognise where this comes from. i wasn’t trying to hide it. inscryption is a huge influence, and i should’ve named it outright instead of being vague. where i tried to go my own way is the auto-battler side: you don’t play cards turn by turn, you build and merge a board and the fight plays out on its own, and each boss changes the rules of that. if it still just feels like inscryption to you, that’s useful to know too.

replies.author: naveed_qasim56
replies.body: added a fix, I hope it works for you now
